title: Singapore Discrete Manufacturing Predictive Maintenance
thesis: Snowflake turns daily readings from a synthetic fleet of CNC machining centers, stamping presses, injection molding machines and industrial robots at six Singapore plants of the fictional Straits Precision Components into uptime KPIs, 7-day failure-risk scores, vibration anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Uptime, unplanned stops, MTBF and spare coverage for 24 production assets at plants in Tuas, Woodlands, Ang Mo Kio, Seletar, Jurong East and Tampines.
Each KPI is an explicit numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, traceable to asset-day rows.
The downtime chart ranks root causes by hours lost, from spindle bearings to hydraulic leaks.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of plant KPIs across every Singapore site

transition.line: Which assets are likely to stop next?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each asset's probability of an unplanned stop in the next 7 days.
The holdout line reports precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, next to the base rate, so the model is judged honestly.
Anomaly detection flags vibration outliers per asset, and the forecast projects fleet downtime hours for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Evaluated ML that runs where the plant data lives

transition.line: Do we have the parts and the PM discipline to respond?

talking_points: Parts on order and spare coverage show whether bearing kits, seal kits, heater bands and servo modules are on hand.
PM compliance against yield by asset shows where the two move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions for Nurul from the KPI, downtime and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human deciding

transition.line: What happens when an asset alarms on the floor right now?

talking_points: Live readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the in-account simulator or from AWS IoT Core through S3 and Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the asset's current risk band, then emails the on-call engineer.
tabs.call_out: From sensor alarm to work instruction in one platform

transition.line: Now ask the plant data directly.

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 16 synthetic SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Natural-language answers that can be audited

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic, seeded demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
